title: Artifact reference
description: An opaque, immutable reference to large evidence. It carries no bucket name, filesystem path, permanent URL, or object credential: resolution goes through the control plane, which rechecks tenant and object linkage and verifies type, size, and digest before returning a bounded result. Missing, expired, redacted, or deleted artifacts fail explicitly, and a digest, size, or type mismatch is an integrity failure. Content-addressed storage never deduplicates across clients, so identical bytes in two client scopes stay independently authorized and deletable.

artifact_type.description: The kind of artifact, for example transcript, telemetry_batch, baseline_chunk_manifest, candidate_manifest, check_log, diff, validation_evidence, or case_file_core. Areas name their own types; the name is part of the contract, not a hint.

schema_version.description: Major version of the artifact's own content schema, independent of this reference contract.

media_type.description: The exact IANA media type of the stored bytes, with optional parameters.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the artifact's exact stored bytes, encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.

byte_size.description: Exact size of the stored bytes. Resolution rejects a mismatch as an integrity failure.

created_at.description: When the artifact became durable. Artifact content is immutable afterwards.

client_scope.description: The tenant that owns the artifact. Resolution reverifies it against the authenticated caller.

retention_class.description: Which retention, export, and deletion rules govern the artifact. The class is fixed at creation; hold and deletion state live on the durable row, not in this immutable reference.

oneOf.title: Participant personal
oneOf.description: Audio, transcripts, and other artifacts of a participant's own participation. Included in participant export and removed by participant deletion.

oneOf.title: Client evidence
oneOf.description: Client-scoped product evidence and outputs: telemetry bundles, candidate manifests, diffs, validation evidence, and sealed Case File cores. Immutable after acceptance and excluded from participant export.

oneOf.title: Operational
oneOf.description: Build and check artifacts and journal material kept for diagnosis and reconstruction, on the shortest retention.

oneOf.title: Audit minimized
oneOf.description: The minimized audit facts that deletion preserves, with references tombstoned rather than removed.
